satellites.title: Continuing to Arise
satellites.evidence: The Xici speaks of unceasing generation: 生生之謂易. Becoming is a process in this textual use, not simply an instant of biological birth.

cites.locator: 繫辭上, 生生之謂易

satellites.title: Birth in Dependent Arising
satellites.evidence: In dependent-arising formulations, 生 denotes birth, associated with Sanskrit jāti. This is not a translation of every instance of the English word becoming.
satellites.caveat: A proposed equivalence awaiting verification in an aligned Sanskrit–Chinese source; citation assignment is not verification.
